description: Post a new top-level entry to a course discussion. Visible to the whole class. Use reply_to_entry to answer someone's entry. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

message.description: Message text. Plain text or simple HTML.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

name: post_entry
